profile.headline: Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer at Nike
profile.summary:
Experienced and versatile developer with broad experience in the academic, commercial, and government sectors.

Specialties: UI development, application development, mobile development, automation

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led development of a web-based version and a native version of an application using React, Redux, React Native, HTML, CSS, TypeScript, Jest.
Led development of a web portal used to manage jobs using React, TypeScript, and Jest.
Set up infrastructure and automation for application using Docker, Terraform, GitHub Actions. Added features to the application using Omniverse Kit and python.
Managed a set of UIs, which included updates, adding new features, etc, using React, TypeScript, Jest, and AWS
Built new UI solutions as plugins for Backstage using React, HTML, TypeScript, and nodejs
positions.insights: Skills: github copilot · TypeScript · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Claude Code Subagents · Cursor AI · Full-Stack Development · React.js · Node.js

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer (at Nike)
positions.description: Developed an admin panel for scheduling and monitoring product launches using React, Redux, nodejs, HTML, CSS, and Jest.
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · Jest · Front-end Development · React.js · Node.js

positions.title: Lead UI Developer (at Walmart)
positions.description:
Lead UI developer on a team that developed desktop and mobile applications for use in supply chain logistics.
Updated, improved, and fixed bugs in desktop and mobile apps using React, Redux, HTML, CSS, TypeScript, and Kubernetes.
Worked with UX designers to finalize mockups.
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · Jest · Front-end Development · React.js · Microsoft Azure

positions.title: Front-End Developer (at Paylynxs)
positions.description: Built the UI for a fraud reporting wizard using Java, JSF, and PrimeFaces.
positions.insights: Skills: Primefaces · Front-end Development · Java · JavaServer Faces (JSF)

positions.title: Cloud Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led UI development on my team by designing and implementing features, planning, and scheduling the development effort, reporting status to the team and to management, presenting demos, managing resources, onboarding new team members, and mentoring engineers. 
Developed a server management system using React, Redux, HTML, CSS, nodejs, webpack, Docker, and Kubernetes.
Led architecture and development of a metrics visualization application using React, HTML, CSS, Beego (a Go app framework), InfluxDB, Docker, and Kubernetes.
Developed automated tests using Jest, Enzyme, and Sinon.
Improved and fixed bugs in Snap telemetry framework plugins using C++.
Received a division recognition award.
positions.insights: Skills: Kubernetes · docker · Full-Stack Development · React.js · Node.js

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed the Android version of a security application using Java, and Android SDK.
Led architecture and development of a crowdfunding application using Ruby on Rails, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and MySQL.
Automated tests for USB3 drivers using C#, shell scripting, Python, and BullseyeCoverage.
Automated tests for a service that powers an Android security application using uiautomator, Java, Android SDK/NDK (Intel assignment) [True Key app in Google Play Store].
Managed a build server and the continuous integration process for a service that powers an Android application using Jenkins, Groovy, and shell scripting (Intel assignment) [True Key app in Google Play Store].
Led the effort in developing tests for a web plugin and a web service using HTML and JavaScript.
Developed a scheduling application using Python, Django, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Postgres.
Automated tests for measuring power consumption for Android devices using Python, Java, and Android SDK.
positions.insights: Skills: Android Development · Python · Java · Ruby on Rails · Mobile Application Development

positions.title: Android Developer (at dot dot dash)
positions.description: Updated, improved, and fixed bugs in an application that controls Christmas via bluetooth lights using Java and Android SDK [Lumenplay app in Google Play Store]
positions.insights: Skills: Android Development · Java · Mobile Application Development

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Collaborated with designers to develop a DJ turntable mobile web application using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, jQuery, jQuery Mobile, JSON, and AllJoyn.
Implemented functionality for a mobile ASP.NET MVC application using HTML, CSS, C#, ASP.NET MVC, JavaScript, jQuery, and jQuery Mobile.
Designed and developed a peer-to-peer Android application using Java, C++, Android SDK/NDK, OpenGL, and AllJoyn.
Wrote unit tests for using JUnit and the Visual Studio Unit Testing Framework.
positions.insights: Skills: Android Development · JavaScript · Web Development · Java · Mobile Application Development

positions.title: Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
Developed new and optimized existing database scripts, applications, and batch jobs for processing student financial aid using SQL, PL/SQL, Pro*C, Perl, shell scripting, VBA, Oracle Forms, and Oracle databases.
Led development of web applications for student financial aid requests, requirements tracking, and yearbook ordering using HTML, CSS, PL/SQL, Java, JavaScript, and Oracle databases.
Designed and implemented a faculty credentials verification web application using HTML, CSS, Java, Flex, ActionScript, XML, Tomcat, BlazeDS, and Oracle databases.
Participated in all stages of the software lifecycle on large-scale, high-volume systems.
Researched and experimented with new web technologies to be used by the department.
Tested patches to the university’s ERP software before deployment.

positions.title: Tutor
positions.description:
Conducted one-on-one tutoring sessions for math, science, and computer science courses.
Tailored tutoring sessions to fit the needs of the individual student athletes.

positions.title: Adjunct Instructor
positions.description:
Instructed computer science courses.
Structured courses according to defined student learning outcomes.
positions.insights: Skills: Teaching · Microsoft Office · Computer Science

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
Participated in the Mississippi Experimental Program to Stimulate Competitive Research (EPSCoR).
Added new functionality to existing scientific visualization applications.
Developed a protein visualization application.
Created plant cell visualizations.
Presented results at EPSCoR conferences.

positions.title: Student Worker
positions.description: Learned Qt and OpenGL in order to develop interfaces for OpenGL applications.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
Participated in the Programming Environment and Training (PET) component of the Department of Defense (DoD) High Performance Computing Modernization Program (HPCMP).  
Created radar data visualizations.
positions.insights: Skills: VTK · Data Visualization · C++ · Paraview

company.name: Aeronautical Systems Center, United States Air Force

positions.title: Student Computer Assistant
positions.description: Assisted incoming freshman students with computer and email setup, network connection, and software installation.

positions.title: Co-op Student Worker
positions.locationName: New Orleans, Louisiana, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Conducted Y2K unit tests.
Developed and maintained a Software Process Improvement website.
Participated on the team that led a department-wide software process improvement effort that resulted in a SEI CMM Level 2 rating.
Lead configuration management activities on several projects.
Participated in peer reviews of project deliverables.
positions.insights: Skills: Configuration Management · Web Development · SEI CMM · Software Development · Unit Testing
